RETENTION. The first 1.5 seconds must contain a visual question the viewer needs resolved. Plan an explicit beat every 2 to 3 seconds; nothing static may hold longer than that.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a handheld follow with visible micro-shake and breathing correction on a 24mm wide, framing with deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a book light bounce producing an extremely soft wrap; grade as a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.
